values.note: The dump station is at the forest's HQ complex on East Street off Route 9, about a mile from the campground (DCR gives directions); food storage lockers at every site for bears.

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 32 Standard Non Electric, 16 Popup/Tent and 1 tent-only site plus a group site 1.5 miles away. All back-in; 26 sites take 24 ft or more (one 30 ft, one 28 ft, the rest 24-26 ft).

note: On a wooded ridge between Upper Highland Lake and a wetland where moose, bear and beaver are common, off Moore Hill Rd in Goshen. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica + mass.gov: $17/$54 (2026 table) and 2026 season 5/7-10/11 (unchanged), 51 sites, no hookups, showers/flush toilets, dump at the HQ complex, max 30 ft (per-site; 26 sites 24 ft+), no pull-throughs, reservations required, 14-day cumulative limit, phone 413-268-7098. Not waterfront confirmed: the loops sit ~200 m back from Upper Highland Lake on imagery and RA tags no site Near Water. Note cleaned of field facts.
